info.name: PhotoApp Backend Demo
info.description: Postman collection for the local PhotoApp backend. It uses bearer tokens captured from the AuthService login and refresh responses, so it does not depend on browser cookies shared across Swagger tabs or service instances.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, email verification, login, refresh, and optional password recovery flows.

item.name: Primary Account
item.description: Main demo identity used for profile and media operations.

exec: pm.environment.set('primary_bio', primaryBio || 'Primary account created through Postman');
console.info('Copy the verification token printed by AuthService.API into primary_verification_token before running Verify Primary Email.');

request.description: Creates a unique demo user. The verification token is printed by AuthService.API to the server console.

exec: console.warn('Paste the verification token from AuthService.API into primary_verification_token before running this request.');

request.description: Completes email verification using the token from the AuthService.API console output.
Logs the primary demo user in and stores the access and refresh tokens in the environment.
Rotates the primary refresh token and updates the bearer token used by later folders.

item.name: Secondary Account
item.description: Second demo identity used to prove sharing and cross-user access.

exec: pm.environment.set('secondary_bio', secondaryBio || 'Secondary account created through Postman');
console.info('Copy the verification token printed by AuthService.API into secondary_verification_token before running Verify Secondary Email.');

request.description: Creates the secondary demo user that will be used to validate shared media access.

exec: console.warn('Paste the verification token from AuthService.API into secondary_verification_token before running this request.');

request.description: Completes email verification for the secondary user.
Logs the secondary demo user in and stores the access and refresh tokens in the environment.
Rotates the secondary refresh token and updates the bearer token used by shared-access checks.

item.name: Recovery
item.description: Optional password recovery flow. The reset token is not returned by an API, so paste it from logs or from your own email integration.

exec: console.warn('Paste the password reset token into primary_reset_token before running Reset Primary Password.');

request.description: Creates a password reset token for the primary user. The current stub email service does not expose the token automatically.

exec: console.warn('Paste the password reset token into primary_reset_token before running this request.');

request.description: Completes the password reset flow once you paste the reset token.

item.name: User Management
item.description: Profile and role operations for the primary user.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Read and update the primary user profile.

request.description: Fetches the primary profile. If this returns 404 immediately after registration, give the consumer a moment and try again.
Updates the primary profile with a new display name, bio, and avatar URL.

item.name: Roles
item.description: Read the assigned roles and exercise the role management endpoints.

request.description: Lists all roles currently assigned to the primary user.
Assigns the seeded Moderator role to the primary user.
Removes the Moderator role again so the demo finishes in a clean state.

item.name: Media
item.description: Album, upload, sharing, and cache-aware media operations.

item.name: Primary Owner Flow
item.description: Main media scenario executed as the primary user.

request.description: Creates the main album that will hold the demo upload.
Creates a second album so the move endpoint has a real target.
Lists the albums owned by the primary user and the ones shared with them.
Reads the album details and primes the cache for later invalidation checks.
Renames the main album so the cache invalidation path gets exercised.
Uploads the included demo fixture. Replace the file with any local JPG or PNG if you want a real image during the presentation.
Reads the uploaded media details and primes the cache for invalidation checks.
Renames the uploaded media item.
Adds a tag to the uploaded media item so the tag assignment and read path can be exercised.
Shares the album with the secondary user using view permissions.
Shares the uploaded media directly with the secondary user using edit permissions.

item.name: Secondary Viewer Flow
item.description: Reads shared resources as the secondary user after the primary user has shared them.

request.description: Lists the albums visible to the secondary user, including shared ones.
Reads the shared album as the secondary user.
Shows the album media list that was shared by the primary user.
Reads the shared media item directly as the secondary user.

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Cleans up the media created during the demo by moving, untagging, and deleting it.

item.name: Move Uploaded Media To Archive Album

request.description: Moves the uploaded media into the archive album before it is deleted.
Removes the tag again so the demo ends with a clean media item.
Deletes the uploaded media item after the secondary user has viewed it.
Deletes the archive album used as the move target.
Deletes the main demo album after the media has been removed.

item.name: Session Cleanup
item.description: Revokes refresh tokens at the very end of the demo.

request.description: Logs out the secondary user after the shared-access checks are done.
Logs out the primary user at the very end of the demo.
